column3: Read jué here, not jiǎo: on the mainland this reading is for a role in a play or film, as in 主角 (the lead) and 配角 (a supporting role). In Taiwan these are usually said zhǔjiǎo and pèijiǎo. The character began as a picture of an animal horn, which is why jiǎo means horn.
